title: GIST: Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformers for Scalable Graph Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2603.16849v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural operators on irregular meshes face a fundamental tension. Spectral positional encodings, a natural choice in graph learning for capturing geometry, require cubic-complexity eigendecomposition and inadvertently break gauge invariance through numerical solver artifacts; existing efficient approximations typically sacrifice gauge symmetry by design. Both failure modes break discretization invariance: models fail to transfer across mesh resolutions of the same domain, and similarly across different graphs of related structure in inductive settings. We propose GIST (Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformer), a scalable neural operator that resolves this tension by restricting attention to pairwise inner products of efficient approximate spectral embeddings. We prove these inner products estimate an exactly gauge-invariant graph kernel at end-to-end $\mathcal{O}(N)$ complexity, and establish a formal connection between gauge invariance

translated_title: GIST：面向可扩展图神经算子的规范不变谱Transformer
translated_abstract: 神经算子在处理不规则网格时面临一个根本性的矛盾。谱位置编码是图学习中捕捉几何结构的自然选择，但它需要立方复杂度的特征值分解，并且会因数值求解器的伪影而无意中破坏规范不变性；而现有高效近似方法通常在设计上就牺牲了规范对称性。这两种失效模式都会破坏离散化不变性：模型无法在同一域的不同网格分辨率之间迁移，在归纳学习场景下也无法在具有相关结构的不同图之间迁移。我们提出GIST（规范不变谱Transformer），这是一种可扩展的神经算子，通过将注意力机制限制在高效近似谱嵌入的两两内积上，解决了这一矛盾。我们证明这些内积能够以端到端 $\mathcal{O}(N)$ 的复杂度估计一个严格规范不变的图核，并建立了规范不变性与（摘要截断于此）
tldr: GIST提出了一种可扩展的规范不变谱Transformer，通过仅对高效近似谱嵌入的两两内积施加注意力，在O(N)复杂度下严格保证规范不变性，实现跨网格分辨率与跨图结构的有效迁移。
en_tdlr: GIST is a scalable gauge-invariant spectral Transformer that restricts attention to pairwise inner products of efficient approximate spectral embeddings, provably estimating an exactly gauge-invariant graph kernel at O(N) complexity while preserving discretization invariance across mesh resolutions and related graphs.
